description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Koswatta, Ridigama D/S Division, Kurunegala District (25/1200083)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels in various districts under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land ownership determinations, cadastral maps, and land title settlement procedures, which directly fits the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
